shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat vite.config.ts && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'

/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p public/images && curl -L --fail --max-time 25 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1441974231531-c6227db76b6e?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1400&q=85' -o public/images/forest.jpg && curl -L --fail --max-time 25 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507842217343-583bb7270b66?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=85' -o public/images/library.jpg && curl -L --fail --max-time 25 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1600210492486-724fe5c67fb0?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=85' -o public/images/interior.jpg && curl -L --fail --max-time 25 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1464822759023-fed622ff2c3b?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=85' -o public/images/mountain.jpg"

/bin/bash -lc "cat index.html && node -e \"for(const p of ['playwright','@playwright/test','puppeteer']){try{console.log(p,import.meta.resolve(p))}catch{console.log(p,'unavailable')}}\" && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > index.html <<'EOF' <"'!doctype html> Тихо — время для себя
EOF cat > public/favicon.svg <<'EOF' EOF npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css src/main.tsx index.html'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const p='/tmp/tiho-browser/check.mjs';fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(\\\"headless: true, args:\\\",\\\"headless: true, executablePath: '/home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome', args:\\\"))\" && npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'which apt-get; which sudo; id; ls /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu | head'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/tiho-libs && cd /tmp/tiho-libs && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0 libavahi-client3 libavahi-common3 libdrm2 libpixman-1-0 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 libthai0 libdatrie1 libharfbuzz0b libgraphite2-3 && for file in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$file" /tmp/tiho-libs/root; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/tiho-libs && apt-get download libwayland-server0 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 libxrender1 libfribidi0 libxi6 libbrotli1 && for file in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$file" /tmp/tiho-libs/root; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/tiho-libs && apt-get download fonts-liberation fontconfig-config && for file in fonts-liberation*.deb fontconfig-config*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$file" /tmp/tiho-libs/root; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/tiho-libs && apt-get download libsqlite3-0 && dpkg-deb -x libsqlite3-0*.deb /tmp/tiho-libs/root && FONTCONFIG_PATH=/tmp/tiho-libs/root/etc/fonts LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/tiho-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/tiho-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/tiho-browser/check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const p='/tmp/tiho-browser/check.mjs';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(\\\"await page.screenshot({path:'/tmp/tiho-mobile.png',fullPage:true});\\\",\\\"await page.waitForTimeout(400); await page.screenshot({path:'/tmp/tiho-mobile.png',fullPage:true});\\\");fs.writeFileSync(p,s)\" && FONTCONFIG_PATH=/tmp/tiho-libs/root/etc/fonts LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/tiho-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/tiho-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/tiho-browser/check.mjs && npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "head -5 src/styles.css && rg -n 'font-family|featured h2 br' src/styles.css && ls -lh /tmp/tiho-mobile.png"
